name: Tyne and Wear
description: Tyne and Wear is a metropolitan county in North East England centred on the River Tyne and the cities of Newcastle and Sunderland. It combines a dense urban landscape and major transport infrastructure with a strong industrial, maritime and cultural heritage.

places.name: Newcastle upon Tyne
places.description: A major city on the River Tyne famous for its iconic bridges, lively nightlife, and roots as a centre of coal export that gave rise to the phrase 'coals to Newcastle.'

places.name: Gateshead
places.description: A town in Tyne and Wear on the south bank of the Tyne, home to the striking Angel of the North sculpture and the Sage music venue on the regenerated quayside.

places.name: North Tyneside
places.description: A coastal district at the mouth of the Tyne, covering the seaside resort of Whitley Bay and the historic priory ruins at Tynemouth.

places.name: South Tyneside
places.description: A district in Tyne and Wear covering South Shields, a seaside town at the mouth of the Tyne with a Roman fort and sweeping sandy beach.

places.name: Sunderland
places.description: A former shipbuilding city in Tyne and Wear on the mouth of the River Wear, once one of the world's largest shipbuilding centres, now home to a growing automotive industry led by Nissan.
